$comment: Which side of the split each tracked file is on. WHY IT EXISTS: the design record calls for the public repository to be a mechanical projection of this one rather than a hand-copied subset, and a projection needs a boundary that a machine can compute. A LIST of what ships can omit a file silently; a PARTITION cannot, so `check_shipped_closure` requires every tracked file to match a rule and every rule to match a file. SCRIPTS ARE NOT LISTED HERE: their side is COMPUTED from reachability, seeded by the scripts SKILL.md tells an agent to run plus `consumer_seeds` below, so a script nobody can reach from the skill's own surface is development by default - the safe direction. FIELDS: `prefix` matches a path exactly or as a directory prefix, longest match wins; `side` is consumer or dev; `why` is the reason, because a boundary nobody can explain is a boundary nobody can maintain.
seeds_comment: Consumer-facing scripts SKILL.md does not name by path: the two the operator runs around a delivery (where it belongs, how it becomes a PDF), the corpus scorer, and the two embedders the deck scaffold calls.
